title: Within-visit pulse-pressure relaxation adds no reliable cross-sample HbA1c prediction beyond mean blood pressure and standard covariates
abstract: Within-visit pulse-pressure relaxation did not show reliable incremental HbA1c prediction in independent NHANES 2009–10 participants: weighted MSE improvement 0.00034881 percentage-point² (95% stratified PSU-bootstrap interval -0.00174849 to 0.00122543), beyond mean BP and standard covariates.
